VALIDATION_ERROR: The entered data is not valid.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
HTTP_ERROR: The request could not be completed.
SERVER_ERROR: The server ran into an error.
VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed the record while you were editing it.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: The same request key was used with different content.
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: The same request is still being processed.
COMPANY_FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this company.
INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_CODE: The verification code is not valid.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You need to change your password before you continue.
INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This action is not possible in the document's current status.
UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
DOCUMENT_LOCKED: The document is no longer a draft and cannot be changed.
SYNC_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: This app version does not match the server. Update the app.
SYNC_CURSOR_INVALID: The sync position is not valid; the data will be downloaded again.
SYNC_RESOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: This data is not synced for offline use.
SYNC_OFFLINE_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED: This change cannot be made offline.
SYNC_BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Too many changes to send at once.
SYNC_DEPENDENCY_FAILED: Not tried because an earlier change it depends on failed.
SYNC_BASE_VERSION_AHEAD: The local copy does not match the server; the record will be downloaded again.
SYNC_CHANGED_FIELDS_MISMATCH: The change record is inconsistent and was not sent.
SYNC_RESOLUTION_INVALID: This conflict resolution is no longer valid.
NO_ACTIVE_PROFILE: There is no active server profile.
ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: Sync is not running right now.
EXTERNAL_OPEN_FAILED: The browser could not be opened.
PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: The server profile was not found.
PROFILES_FILE_INVALID: The profiles file cannot be read.
DESKTOP_UPDATE_REQUIRED: This server needs a newer version of the desktop app.
PROFILE_RECORD_MALFORMED: The profile's session record is damaged.
PROFILE_HAS_PENDING_WORK: This profile has unsent changes or open conflicts.
PROFILE_BUSY: The profile is busy. Try again shortly.
COMPANY_NOT_AVAILABLE: This company is not available to your account.
STORE_KEY_INVALID: The key of the local data cannot be read.
STORE_ERROR: The local data store ran into an error.
STORE_MIGRATION_INVALID: The local data store cannot be opened with this version.
DECODE_ERROR: The server response could not be read.
TOKEN_STORE_ERROR: The session could not be read from or written to secure storage.
INVALID_SERVER_URL: The server address is not valid.
NOT_IMPLEMENTED: This feature is not in the desktop app yet.
INVALID_REQUEST: This request cannot be sent from the desktop app.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The data sent is too large.
REQUEST_STALE: The answer was dropped because the company or session changed.
INVALID_URL: The request address is not valid.
STREAM_UNAVAILABLE: Streaming answers are not available in the desktop app.
